rules.message: [pi-flow] Grill is mandatory in plan/autopilot unless the user explicitly passed --skip-grill. Pause for browser Submit or structured answers.
[pi-flow] Before claiming done on HTML artifacts: run paperflow_verify on the doc URL (or document SKIP).
[pi-flow] Force-push requires explicit user approval. Never assume.
[pi-flow] >30 LOC → dispatch worker subagent. See lib/paperflow-thresholds.md.
